rule_text.name: 702.280a
rule_text.rule: Resilience is a triggered ability. “Resilience” means “When this permanent is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, exile it, then create a token that's a copy of it, except the token is 1/1 and doesn't have resilience.”

rule_text.name: 702.280b
rule_text.rule: If a permanent has multiple instances of resilience, multiple 1/1 token copies of it will be created, but those tokens will lose all instances of resilience.

rule_text.name: 702.283a
rule_text.rule: Attain is an activated ability of some double-faced permanents. “Attain (cost)” means “(cost): Transform this permanent. Spend mana of at least three different colors to activate this ability. Activate only as a sorcery.”

rule_text.name: 702.283b
rule_text.rule: One card (Janneke, Adept of Mortals) says a player “may spend any number of colors of mana to activate attain abilities.” This causes the “Spend mana of at least three different colors to activate this ability.” part of attain abilities to be ignored.

rule_text.name: 702.283c
rule_text.rule: Attain will check the colors of mana actually spent to activate the ability, even if an effect allows them to be spent as though they were mana of a different color.

rule_text.name: 702.283d
rule_text.rule: Some triggered abilities trigger when a player “attains” an object with a specified characteristic. Such an ability triggers if the object is transformed as a result of its attain ability and has the specified characteristic immediately after it does so.

rule_text.name: 702.283a
rule_text.rule: Attain is an activated ability of some double-faced permanents. “Attain (cost)” means “(cost): Transform this permanent. Spend mana of at least three different colors to activate this ability. Activate only as a sorcery.”

rule_text.name: 702.283b
rule_text.rule: One card (Janneke, Adept of Mortals) says a player “may spend any number of colors of mana to activate attain abilities.” This causes the “Spend mana of at least three different colors to activate this ability.” part of attain abilities to be ignored.

rule_text.name: 702.283c
rule_text.rule: Attain will check the colors of mana actually spent to activate the ability, even if an effect allows them to be spent as though they were mana of a different color.

rule_text.name: 702.283d
rule_text.rule: Some triggered abilities trigger when a player “attains” an object with a specified characteristic. Such an ability triggers if the object is transformed as a result of its attain ability and has the specified characteristic immediately after it does so.

rule_text.name: 702.284a
rule_text.rule: Deploy is a static ability. “Deploy N” means “As this permanent enters, you may tap any number of other untapped creatures you control with total power N or more. If you do, this permanent is deployed.” Tapping the creatures is a cost (see rule 118) and may be referred to as paying the permanent's deploy cost.

rule_text.name: 702.284b
rule_text.rule: Deployed is a designation that has no rules meaning other than to act as a marker that spells and abilities can identify. Only permanents can be or become deployed. rule_text.name: 702.284c
rule_text.rule: A permanent “enters deployed” as it enters the battlefield if its deploy cost was paid.

rule_text.name: 702.284a

rule_text.name: 702.290a
rule_text.rule: Crumble is a keyword that represents four abilities. “Crumble [cost]” means “You may cast this card by paying [cost] rather than its mana cost,” "This permanent enters with three time counters if its crumble cost was paid," “At the beginning of your upkeep, if this permanent has a time counter on it, remove a time counter from it,” and “When the last time counter is removed from this permanent, sacrifice it and draw a card.” Casting a spell for its crumble cost follows the rules for paying alternative costs in rules 601.2b and 601.2f–h.

rule_text.name: 702.290b
rule_text.rule: If a permanent has multiple instances of crumble, each works separately.

rule_text.name: 702.292a
rule_text.rule: Memory appears on some instants and sorceries. It represents two static abilities: one that functions while the card is in a player’s graveyard and another that functions while the card is on the stack. “Memory (cost)” means “You may cast this card from your graveyard if the resulting spell is an instant or sorcery spell by paying (cost) and discarding a card rather than pay its mana cost” and “If this spell was cast using its memory ability, exile this card instead of putting it anywhere else any time it would leave the stack.” Casting a spell using its memory ability follows the rules for paying alternative costs in rules 601.2b and 601.2f–h.
